mechanism: Binance and Coinbase requests used the global retry policy, whose write retries are controlled by TRADER_HTTP_RETRY_WRITES. With it enabled, an order POST whose response was lost (timeout or connection reset after the exchange accepted it) would be re-sent; Binance rejects a duplicate client order id only while the first order is still open, so a filled market order could be placed twice.
witness: Model mutant retry-writes: the order applies, its response is lost, the transport re-sends it and it applies again (position 2 against target 1).
resolution: Exchange requests use venueRetryConfig (write retries off regardless of the flag); unknown outcomes are recovered by re-reading venue state on the next decision or by client-order-id reconciliation.
